content: Snipe-IT label mechanics (verified from official docs): select assets via checkboxes in any listing view, Generate Labels in bulk dropdown; layout/size in Admin>Settings>Labels; label carries 1D barcode (encodes asset tag for USB scanner lookup) and 2D QR (deep-link to asset page readable by any phone QR app); barcodes enabled in settings; generates printable sheets, not server-side printing.
